neighbours.label: the brain or nervous system named as a thing studied or imaged ('Einstein's brain', 'the brains of mice', 'the nervous system of larvae')
fire: Scientists scanned the brain of each volunteer during the memory task.
She dissected the brains of several rats from the control group.
The study mapped the nervous system of a small worm cell by cell.
Autopsies revealed damage to the brain in most of the boxers.
Researchers imaged the brains of musicians while they listened to scales.
The neurologist compared the brain of the patient with a healthy one.
He spent years studying the nervous system of the common fruit fly.
New pictures of the human brain show how sleep changes it.
quiet: Scientists scanned the heart of each volunteer during the running task.
She dissected the kidneys of several rats from the control group.
The study mapped the skeleton of a small fish bone by bone.
Autopsies revealed damage to the lungs in most of the miners.
Researchers imaged the hands of musicians while they played their scales.
The cardiologist compared the heart of the patient with a healthy one.
He spent years studying the wings of the common fruit fly.
New pictures of the human stomach show how food changes it.

short: the brain as an object of study
